title: Sources: Supabase is in talks to raise ~$500M at a ~$10B valuation, roughly doubling its October 2025 valuation; GIC is expected to lead the funding round (Katie Roof/The Information)
summary: Katie Roof / The Information: Sources: Supabase is in talks to raise ~$500M at a ~$10B valuation, roughly doubling its October 2025 valuation; GIC is expected to lead the funding round — Singapore's GIC is in talks to lead an investment in database startup Supabase at a valuation of about $10 billion …
